master.description: Marin mountain bike shoes offer a supportive fit with a supple upper and a stiff, lugged sole to enhance pedal efficiency when grinding uphill and through the dirt.
master.features: Microfiber synthetic leather and nylon mesh uppers give a glovelike fit with excellent breathability Carbon composite road soles offer more rigidity than a nylon sole, providing a direct connection with the pedal, solid power transfer and excellent aerodynamics High traction lugs on outsoles enhance grip and durability in muddy conditions
master.name: Marin Mountain Bike Shoes
master.reviews:
By Boise mtn biker
from Boise, ID Great shoe. Been riding a long time and tried many shoes, this one is well built, fits me as well as any mtn bike shoe I've had, and seems like it will last. If you don't want to spend $$$ on carbon soled shoes, these shoes might do you well.
